title: Strict proper/open reconstruction with the recorded finite projections
statement: Let k be a field and l a prime invertible in k, E/Q_l finite, and f:X→Y a separated finite-type morphism of finite-type k-schemes with compactification c=(j,p), j quasi-compact. Use the actual completed coefficient categories and reduction functors [lem-fix-compactification-completed-realization-data]. There is a coherent coefficient reduction calculus S on Y for which j!K is integral constructible for every integral constructible K. Its strict reduction of Rp*j! is naturally isomorphic, by beta, to the recorded compact-support strict tower. The recorded integral compact-support functor is naturally isomorphic, by gamma, to the total limit of that tower. The projections of gamma are exactly the finite scalar-adjunction units followed by restriction of the recorded finite reduction isomorphisms. The recorded canonical realization equals the reduction/limit unit followed by limit(beta) and gamma inverse. Evaluation of beta is strictEvaluation followed by restriction of the scalar reduction of that canonical realization and its recorded finite reduction isomorphism. No tensor, projection formula, Tor-amplitude condition, or claim of faithfulness of evaluation is part of this assertion.

proof.text: Put $H=j_!K$. The DVR and standard-quotient results make $A=\mathcal O_E$ Noetherian with finite perfect quotients and torsion residue field. Finite type over the Noetherian field makes the schemes Noetherian. Strict open reduction gives $H_n\cong j_{!,n}K_n$ and completeness of $H$; finite open extension preserves constructibility and the common interval of the $K_n$, hence $H\in D^b_c$.

Apply ordinary $Rp_{*,R}$ to the actual completion unit of $H$, then its strict direct-image/limit comparison. Coefficient restriction gives $a_H:Rp_{*,R}H\cong R\lim\operatorname{Res}_nRp_{*,n}H_n$. Apply proper image to $r_j(K)$ to obtain the strict tower isomorphism $\beta_\bullet$. The proper-image tower lemma identifies its transitions with the defining compact-support transitions. Set $d_c=R\lim(\beta_\bullet)a_H$.

Integral direct-image constructibility applied to $p,H$ identifies this limit with a constructible complete object with a uniform bound. The direct-image/limit theorem identifies its augmented reduction diagram with perfect projection; the evaluation adjunction identifies its projections with reduction adjuncts. Composing with $r_j(K)_n$ gives exactly the ordered proper-projection/open-tensor comparison induced by $d_c$.

theorem strictRealization [QuasiCompact c.i] :
    ∃ S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E Y,
    Nonempty (CoefficientDerivedSystemCoherence l E Y S) ∧
    (∀ K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X,
      sfIntegralConstructible l E c.Z
        ((openExtension (completed l E) c.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj K.obj)) ∧
    ∃ (β : (sfIntegralConstructible l E X).ι ⋙ image (completed l E) c ⋙
          strictReduction l E Y S ≅
        (sfIntegralConstructible l E X).ι ⋙ supportTower l E c k hl)
      (γ : sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor l k hl c E ⋙
          (sfIntegralConstructible l E Y).ι ≅
        (sfIntegralConstructible l E X).ι ⋙ supportTower l E c k hl ⋙
          coefficientConstantTowerLimit l E Y),
    (∀ (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) (n : ℕ),
      γ.hom.app K ≫ (coefficientConstantTowerProjection l E Y n).app
          ((supportTower l E c k hl).obj K.obj) ≫
          (supportEvaluation l E c k hl n).hom.app K.obj =
        (coefficientFiniteAdjunction l E Y n).unit.app
            ((sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor l k hl c E).obj K).obj ≫
          (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E Y n).map
            (sfCompactSupportFiniteReductionIso l k hl c E K n).hom) ∧
    (∀ K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X,
      (sfQcqsCompactSupportRealization l E k hl c).hom.app K =
        S.adjunction.unit.app ((image (completed l E) c).obj K.obj) ≫
          (coefficientConstantTowerLimit l E Y).map (β.hom.app K) ≫ γ.inv.app K) ∧
    (∀ (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X) (n : ℕ),
      (coefficientConstantTowerEvaluation l E Y n).map (β.hom.app K) ≫
          (supportEvaluation l E c k hl n).hom.app K.obj =
        (strictEvaluation l E S n).hom.app ((image (completed l E) c).obj K.obj) ≫
          (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E Y n).map
            ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E Y n).map
                ((sfQcqsCompactSupportRealization l E k hl c).hom.app K) ≫
              (sfCompactSupportFiniteReductionIso l k hl c E K n).hom))
